Need 14 Android Testers for 14 Days
SPARK Consultancy needs a provider or coordinator who can arrange 14 different people with their own Android phones and Google accounts to test our app, SPARK HomeBites, a homemade-food marketplace.

Scope

Arrange 14 genuine Android testers.

Each tester must join our Google Play closed test and remain opted in continuously for at least 14 days.

Complete five short testing sessions per person during the assignment.

Provide genuine feedback, bug screenshots, and a consolidated final report.

Coordinate replacements promptly if anyone drops out. A replacement’s required participation period starts when they join, so the schedule may need extending.

Step-by-step testing instructions

Provide the 14 testers’ Google email addresses privately after the project is awarded.

Wait for us to add them to the tester list and confirm the start date.

Each tester opens the supplied opt-in link using their approved Google account, selects “Become a tester,” and installs the app through Google Play.

Register a HomeBites buyer account using an app-specific password. Test login, logout, and login again.

Browse kitchens and food listings; check search, food details, and navigation.

Add items to the cart and check quantities, subtotal, packing charges, delivery charges, and checkout.

Place test orders only with a designated test kitchen after our confirmation. No real food purchase or payment is required.

Coordinate with us to check order tracking and whether orders remain visible after reopening the app.

Retest assigned fixes and submit final feedback.

Keep the app installed and remain opted in throughout the agreed testing period.

Required deliverables

Participation tracker showing each tester’s joining date and completed sessions.

Brief results from all 14 testers, including tasks attempted and problems found.

Screenshots for reported bugs, with personal information hidden.

One consolidated final report listing issues and retest results.

The agreed total will be divided into these milestones:

25%: All 14 testers have joined, installed the app, and submitted initial testing results.

35%: Midpoint testing sessions and progress report completed.

40%: Full participation period completed and final reports submitted.

Payment is for completed testing and honest feedback. App bugs or properly documented failed attempts will not disqualify testers from payment. Payment does not depend on positive reviews or Google granting production access.

Incomplete milestones will not be paid. Fabricated evidence, duplicate identities, or copied reports will not be accepted. Completed and accepted milestones remain payable. Missing deliverables must be corrected within two days of notification.

All milestones and payments must follow the hiring platform’s rules.

Security

We will share the tester invitation link and testing instructions. We will not share Google passwords, OTPs, Firebase access, Play Console administrator access, or Android signing keys.

Please include in your proposal

Your total quote for all 14 testers.

Confirmation that testers are different people using their own Android devices.

Your earliest start date.

How you track participation and collect feedback.

Your replacement policy.

A sample testing report, if available.

We may offer future projects if this assignment is completed reliably.
